description: This file defines the ExternalTypeGrain class, which implements the IExternalTypeGrain interface. It contains methods for retrieving models, including an abstract model and an enum model, and uses dependency injection for logging.

classes.name: ExternalTypeGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IExternalTypeGrain, providing methods to retrieve models and logging activities.

methods.name: GetAbstractModel
methods.description: Returns a completed task after logging a debug message; intended to retrieve an abstract model based on input collection.

methods.name: GetEnumModel
methods.description: Returns a task with an EnumClass instance containing a list with DateTimeKind.Local.
